title: Cyrus and the Inheritance
author: Sable Vasquez
blurb: Juniper Okafor, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
